answer: Proof-of-stake serves as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism where validator identity is tied to capital lockup rather than a fable of decentralization. By requiring a relic of value, such as native tokens, an attacker must acquire significant supply to gain consensus influence. This creates a gale of financial pressure, as the cost of a majority attack scales linearly with the total staked amount, rendering identity spoofing economically irrational in a secure, bonded network environment.
